raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question “In between The Bears and I and Oceans, which was released on July 31, 1974, by Buena Vista Distribution?” as asking for a film chronologically between those two titles, instead of selecting which of the two given films matches the date. This led the process down an irrelevant path (searching for an intermediate Buena Vista release like “The Island at the Top of the World”) despite evidence that The Bears and I was released on July 31, 1974.
